title: fix(sessions): commit invitation membership with involvement
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Invitation membership and mention involvement must commit together and immediately reach retained authorization readers.

## User Impact

Adds an atomic membership/involvement operation and publishes exact committed member changes, including actor and in-flight read postimages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Extend the existing SQLite transaction and publication owners. Reuse existing tables and watermarks; no schema bump or parallel ACL store.

Stack step **13/17**, now targeting main after the prerequisite landings. Review and merge in order; each upper PR contains only its own slice against its predecessor.

Previous: [wait for public startup admission in chat fixtures](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185983), closed as superseded by #186287; the branch is kept. Coordination cleanup #185982 is merged.

Next: [commit invitations with original messages; release retained authority](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184512).

Stack order: [complete stack](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184515#stack-order).

## Evidence

### Current qualification — 2026-11-02

Head: [e1cb25ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e1cb25ea5fc6b534b8dd7eaa1725d8c8698f5155). Main base: [c9cd215b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9cd215bf94ffdb466ca32674ea3f305edfc1de3). Only this slice's single commit was restacked; #184512 and upper stack branches were not changed. The writer-registry conflict preserves main's private-restore sink and the invitation transaction's exact caller registration.

Both blocking prerequisites are on main: [#188056](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188056) repairs the inherited terminal-notice assertions, and [#188055](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188055) repairs reader-validation capture during queued admission (merged as e3064bf7fe0206310600506f778374725de08f89). The [exact-head CI gate succeeded](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41399384933/job/125133938471). Hosted review is recorded in the [canonical ClawSweeper comment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184511#issuecomment-6414280481).

Local qualification: **172/172 tests across six scoped suites**, core and affected session/tooling test typechecks, targeted type-aware lint, formatting and diff checks passed. Main's test ceiling and allocations are unchanged: **6,387,509 lines / 6,399,928 allowed**. SQLite live T1 calls remain **168 → 168**, with T1-compat **15 → 15**. The cold scoped command took 533.49 seconds, dominated by bundle transformation. An initial broad SDK-declaration setup timed out; required targeted lint then passed through the repository's canonical source-backed projects, with no skip flags, rule changes or timeout changes in tests. The isolated pairing scope-cap check separately passed **1/1** (15 unrelated cases were not selected).

#### AWS integration comparison — complete

Doctor passed before fresh lease **cbx_a3bb19a9dd62**, profile **openclaw-check**, machine **c7a.2xlarge**, measured **8 CPUs / 15,613 MiB RAM**, Node **24.19.0**. [Run run_49e45539bf60d015d71fc525bf64e25c](https://crabbox.openclaw.ai/portal/runs/run_49e45539bf60d015d71fc525bf64e25c) completed successfully. Both pinned revisions were independently installed, built and exercised through their real built Gateways with isolated state and ports. Head/base builds took **349 s / 379 s**; their Gateway comparisons took **143 s / 144 s**.

Synthetic A is the creator, B the invited member and C the non-member. Each signs the Gateway nonce; the normal trusted-proxy pairing owner enrolls the device under an explicit narrow scope cap and per-identity scope limits. The proxy is synthetic, not an external identity-provider integration. No model turn or provider credential was used.

The only unpushed tracked source change on either revision enables the existing invitation policy for proof, in src/config/zod-schema.gateway.ts:

    -    others: z.enum(["none", "view", "suggest", "write"]),
    +    others: z.enum(["none", "invited", "view", "suggest", "write"]),

| Integration-test plan / expected result | Actual on head | Actual on main base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Existing view/none describe, list and history access remains identical before add, after add, after restart and after removal | Passed | Passed; all **72** corresponding access rows identical |
| Under invited, A adds B; B's next read and list gain access while C receives neither | Passed through public membership RPC and real Gateway | Passed through the same public route |
| Committed membership survives Gateway restart; A removes B and B's very next request on the retained connection is denied | Passed | Passed |
| Atomic mention/invitation owner records involvement and grants B; restarted Gateway admits B and denies C | Passed | Existing mention-only control records involvement but grants no membership or access |
| After removal, the watermark remains; replay of the same source, older sequence or older generation cannot restore membership; restarted Gateway still denies B/C | Passed | Passed; main remains without membership |
| Forced transaction/commit-admission failure leaves neither membership nor involvement changes | Committed owner suites passed **27/27** on AWS, including exact failure identity and unchanged preimage | PR-only atomic invitation input is absent; no equivalent main operation is claimed |

Both revisions passed **196/196 expected/actual checks**. The committed rollback coverage is in session-involvement-store.worker.test.ts and its sharing-owner sibling. Public membership and Gateway access are separate from the PR-only owner operation: this prefix does not activate the later human-mention caller. Offline owner calls run only after Gateway stop joins, acquire exclusive custody, and close workers before returning custody for restart. No ownership, authorization, cleanup or temporary-root guard was disabled. History is empty, so those rows prove admission rather than transcript rendering.

The lease was released and independently inspected: **state=released, hasHost=false, ready=false, cleanupStatus=complete, provisioningResourceMayExist=false**, cleanup completed **2026-11-02T09:09:01.049Z**. Collected stdout remained readable after release with unchanged SHA-256 **aa6f30965a9eb57ac4621e0731abf287f07d547601c7693e3af5dc4775089d57**.

An earlier same-head attempt stopped at device-pairing setup before access assertions ran. Its lease cbx_da52f29efe63 was also released with complete cleanup. The corrected fixture uses the documented trustedProxy.deviceAutoApprove option with explicit bounded scopes; its nonce signatures, identity checks and durable pairing readback remain in force.

Main's canonical fixture repairs are preserved and duplicate prerequisite changes removed. Prefixes are not separately built locally; this prefix's hosted CI and review are recorded below.

Sharing/involvement worker tests cover stale expected entries, replay watermarks and retained-reader publication. The final real-invitation SessionManager matrix adds actor and non-actor commit/rollback proof, including readers acquired before the write. Existing tables and schema versions are unchanged.

The extracted insert helper is registered with the writer guard. Its native wrapper and atomic involvement transaction are the only permitted callers; negative fixtures reject additional callers, including another function in the same worker file.

The [stack evidence ledger](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184515#evidence) records runtime results, prior build/upgrade proof and limits. Integration tests are owned by the final activation PR. Current-head hosted CI and review remain required before landing.

## Change size

Production and tooling **+253/-119**; tests **+200/-36**; generated inventory **+2/-2**. The growth reuses the existing transaction, commit-receipt and retained-publication owners; it adds no store, schema migration, protocol or config activation.

### Test-line allowance

Main’s scalar ceiling and existing allocations are unchanged. Final canonical count: **6,387,509**, below the existing effective ceiling **6,399,928**. No test deletion or assertion weakening was used to fit the budget.

<details>
<summary>Prior-head qualification and investigations — historical</summary>

### CI dependency follow-up — 2026-10-30

Both originally reported failures have scoped repairs. The inherited concise-notice test mismatch is merged in [#188056](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188056), squash `b848e52d0490ea31ffe6067a2fbddff83a1552e1`, after green exact-head CI and clean review. The transcript-reader failure is an inherited admission-ordering race in an unchanged owner: a preceding writer renews validation while a queued read retains its revoked receipt. [#188055](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188055) has a deterministic real-worker red/green regression, Node 24 repeated controls on head/base, corrected test types and clean exact-head review at `bf14009ac769a40b83f2c785361d4084fe239fb6`.

That dependency remains unmerged because its artifact-build job timed out rendering bundled root help after 120 seconds. A bounded isolated Node 24 build at its exact head passed, but that is not a fix or CI waiver. No CI rerun was requested. Consequently this stack PR remains at `a17fcb30f8a06286c8f2009f9e9c7f8f6c1d14e3`: it has not been rebased or force-pushed before main contains both repairs. Its completed AWS evidence and released lease below remain pinned to that original tested head, not relabeled as new-head proof. #184512 and upper stack branches are untouched.

The follow-up [bounded root-help audit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188055#evidence) found no matching timeout in 24 readable scheduled-main logs or three executed other-PR logs over the selected 24-hour creation window (33 other-PR jobs skipped). Source tracing at the actual failed synthetic merge found no causal path from the reader repair; the hosted hang remains unattributed, with no proven fix. Both PRs remain blocked under the requested green-only gates. No speculative patch, timeout increase, CI rerun or chase rebase was made.

### Current qualification — 2026-10-30

Final head: `a17fcb30f8a06286c8f2009f9e9c7f8f6c1d14e3`; main base: `589348d08f45e2509a59b2e17de7943377a58f8f`. This is a patch-identical rebase of the previously reviewed `b32303a4` slice. No upper stack branch was changed.

All six scoped suites passed **171/171**: sharing/involvement owners 27, writer guard 101, replacement receipts 24, actor publication/replica siblings 19. `tsgo:core`, affected tooling typecheck, targeted type-aware lint, formatting, diff checks and the database-worker ratchet passed. Live T1 calls remain **168 → 168**. Main's test-line ceiling and allocations are unchanged: **6,281,410** lines against **6,328,569** allowed.

#### AWS integration comparison — complete

AWS doctor passed. Fresh lease `cbx_c6e64594bd79`, profile `openclaw-check`, machine `c7a.2xlarge`, measured **8 CPUs / 15,613 MiB RAM**. Run `run_3308fa83314485e91c17a4898ea0cbdb` exited **0**. Both pinned revisions were independently built and exercised through their real built Gateways with isolated state/ports and synthetic A (creator), B (invited member), C (non-member). Signed devices and the existing trusted-proxy fixture resolved the three profiles; no model turn or provider credential was used.

The only unpushed tracked source delta on both revisions was `src/config/zod-schema.gateway.ts`:

```diff
-    others: z.enum(["none", "view", "suggest", "write"]),
+    others: z.enum(["none", "invited", "view", "suggest", "write"]),
```

| Integration-test plan / expected result | Actual on head | Actual on main base |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `view` and `none` retain their existing describe/list/history outcomes before membership, after add, after restart and after removal | Passed | Passed; all **54** corresponding access rows identical |
| Under `invited`, B/C start hidden; A adds B; B immediately gains describe/list/history access while C remains hidden | Passed | Passed through the ordinary public membership RPC |
| Committed public membership survives Gateway restart; A removes B and B's next request on the retained socket is denied | Passed | Passed |
| Atomic mention/invitation owner grants B membership and records involvement; restarted Gateway admits B and denies C | Passed | Control records the existing mention without the PR-only invitation input; no membership or access is granted |
| After A removes the atomic grant, the involvement watermark remains; replaying the same source, an older sequence, or an older generation does not restore membership; booted Gateway still denies B/C | Passed | Passed; main remains without membership |
| Forced transaction/commit-admission failure leaves neither new membership nor an involvement change | Existing committed owner integration passed; exact error identity and unchanged preimage checked | PR-only atomic invitation operation is absent |

Both revisions passed **174/174 expected/actual checks**; all **10 offline-owner receipts** were verified. Public membership and real Gateway authorization are distinct from the PR-only owner operation: the later stack slice activates the human-mention caller. The offline helper joins Gateway stop, acquires exclusive state custody, runs the ordinary worker operation (not native schema maintenance), closes resources and returns custody before restart. No authorization, native-owner, cleanup or temp-root guard was disabled. History is empty, so these rows prove admission rather than transcript rendering; the upstream proxy is synthetic rather than an external identity-provider test.

The lease was released and independently inspected at **2026-10-30T01:47:18.126Z**: `state=released`, `hasHost=false`, `ready=false`, `cleanupStatus=complete`, `provisioningResourceMayExist=false`. #### Previous-head CI investigation — historicals

[CI run 40985610733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40985610733) completed with two failed Node jobs and a failed `openclaw/ci-gate`; the green-only landing condition is not met. No CI rerun or dispatch was requested.

- [changed compact-small-18-1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40985610733/job/123836261936): `server.sessions.create.projects.test.ts`, both remote-project retry cases, expected the detailed Git-clone failure notice but received the generic terminal failure notice. **Inherited:** both identical assertions also fail on the untouched exact main base `589348d0`. This needs a separate repair before the requested green-only merge.
